name: Firefox DevTools MCP
description: Lets MCP clients automate and debug a local Firefox via WebDriver BiDi: navigate pages, fill forms, inspect network and console, and take screenshots.

skills.name: Page Management
skills.description: Lists, selects, and navigates Firefox tabs with list_pages, select_page, and navigate_page, including headless runs and Firefox for Android.

skills.name: Snapshot And Input
skills.description: Takes a DOM snapshot with element UIDs, then clicks or fills elements by UID with click_by_uid and fill_by_uid to drive forms.

skills.name: Network And Console
skills.description: Captures network requests and console messages for inspection with list_network_requests, get_network_request, and list_console_messages.

skills.name: Screenshots And Downloads
skills.description: Captures page screenshots with screenshot_page and tracks or configures file downloads with list_downloads and set_download_behavior.
